title: Remove or wire up HierarchyBrowserState's unused currentPath/canGoBack public getters
why: Both are documented as 'Public API for external callers' reachable via the widget's GlobalKey, but the sole caller (HierarchySelectionPanel) never accesses `_browserKey.currentState?.currentPath` or `.canGoBack` — only `.navigateBack()` and `.clearNavigation()` are ever invoked through the key. The caller instead maintains its own parallel `_navigationStack`/`canGoBack` state fed via the onNavigationChanged callback, duplicating the same information HierarchyBrowserState already tracks internally.
recommendation: Delete the two unused getters (and their doc-comment mention) unless a near-term caller is planned; if HierarchySelectionPanel's parallel navigation-stack tracking is meant to be temporary, replace it with these getters instead of keeping both.
acceptance_criteria: No lib/ reference to HierarchyBrowserState.currentPath or .canGoBack exists, or a real caller uses them in place of a duplicate local navigation stack.
